controls.name: Uniflair room units with pCO1 / UpCO1 control and graphic terminal (CW, DX, Energy Saving, Twin-Cool; EVD400 EEV driver)
controls.description: APC-era (2012) Uniflair room cooling control: the ALARM button flashes red when an alarm is active; press it to silence the buzzer and read the description (the last two lines suggest solutions); hold it several seconds to reset once the cause is removed. 100-event alarm history (with date/time if the clock card is fitted). Two voltage-free alarm contacts (Type A / Type B; all alarms default A). In a LAN (up to 10 units, 1-2 standby, rotation default 168 h) selected alarms start the standby unit. Names below are the parameter-table alarm names (the on-screen messages are pictures in the manual).

diagnosticTips: Temperature/humidity limit alarms are delayed at start-up (default 10 min after power on per the defaults table; the text says 15 min).
Incorrect phase sequence on 3-phase units blocks all operation at power-up: swap two supply phases.
Defaults: room cooling setpoint 23.0°C (band 1.5), dehumidification 55 % RH, humidification 45 % RH; alarms 30/10°C and 80/30 % RH; minimum compressor OFF 60 s, minimum time between starts 360 s.
Passwords are in the envelope supplied with the unit (range 0-32000).
pCO firmware is loaded with WinLoad32 / pCO Manager via USB-RS485, or a Carel SmartKey (can clone a pCO to an identical pCO with pLAN disconnected).

UG40 'Uniguard' terminal (Leonardo Evolution, about 2007-2012): 64x120 px LCD, 6 keys, up to 10 units on LAN with 1-2 rotating standby units, 100-event history; Twin-Cool can be forced to CW on a compressor alarm. Its alarm list was not obtained.

High Capacity Uniflair units (4500/5000 models): high/low temperature and humidity, high/low airflow, EEV error, low pressure and insufficient CW flow auto-clear when the condition is gone (Schneider FAQ FA231657, search excerpt).

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.

Idle-mode alarms (manual p.17): Condensate Pump Fault, Cooling Failure, Water Detection Fault (if Idle On Leak = Yes; optional leak sensor AP9325), Persistent High Head Pressure and VFD Inverter Over Heated put the unit in idle mode.
Compressor drive diagnostics on the display: Heat Sink temperature, Ctrl Card temperature, Warn Stat (hex warning word), Alrm Stat (hex alarm word).

Field notes (medium): 'Compressor drive fault exists' on a new ACRP102 - swap VFDs between units to see whether the fault follows the drive; never wire the compressor directly across the line (Schneider community). The RP raises 'Excessive Compressor Cycling' after 12 compressor cycles in one hour and it must be cleared manually (Schneider FAQ FA163655, search excerpt).

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.
'Persistent High Head Pressure' = four compressor high-pressure shutdowns in 30 min; clear manually.
Return humidity thresholds: high 35-90 % RH, low 20-50 % RH. Optional leak sensor AP9326.

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.

diagnosticTips: Alarm LED: off = no alarm, solid yellow = warning, solid red = critical. A new alarm beeps every 30 s until silenced by any function key.
Active alarms are cleared on the Active Alarms screen with the Admin password; conditions still present regenerate the alarm.
Group (A-Link) alarms: check the 'number of units in group' setting and the A-Link cabling and terminators. Sensor faults: reseat the sensor, then replace.
Run-hours 'violations' are service reminders: reset the counter in View Run Hours after maintenance.
The built-in Network Management Card serves web/SNMP/Modbus; NMC status LED: solid green = valid TCP/IP, flashing green = no TCP/IP, solid orange = hardware fault, flashing orange = BOOTP.
R-32 (A2L) unit: Refrigerant Leak Alarm and Fan Speed Too Low Alarm relate to leak mitigation airflow; treat a leak alarm as a refrigerant-safety event.
